name: scrapingant_scrape
description: Scrape a web page and return its raw HTML via ScrapingAnt (headless-browser rendering + rotating proxies). Handles JS-heavy sites and anti-bot pages. Example: scrapingant_scrape({ url: "https://example.com", browser: true, _apiKey: "your-key" })

url.description: The absolute URL of the page to scrape, e.g. "https://example.com/products"

browser.description: Render the page in a headless browser (executes JavaScript). Default true. Set false for a faster raw HTTP fetch of static pages.

proxy_type.description: Proxy pool to use: "datacenter" (default, cheaper) or "residential" (harder to block).

proxy_country.description: Two-letter ISO country code for the proxy exit location, e.g. "US", "GB", "DE".

wait_for_selector.description: CSS selector to wait for before returning (e.g. ".price"). Only applies when browser rendering is on.

js_snippet.description: Custom JavaScript to run in the page after load (plain JS — this pack base64-encodes it for you). Only applies when browser rendering is on.

_apiKey.description: Your ScrapingAnt API key. Sign up free at https://app.scrapingant.com/signup

name: scrapingant_markdown
description: Fetch a web page and return clean, LLM-ready Markdown (boilerplate stripped) via ScrapingAnt. Ideal for feeding page content to a model. Example: scrapingant_markdown({ url: "https://example.com/article", _apiKey: "your-key" })

url.description: The absolute URL of the page to convert to Markdown, e.g. "https://example.com/blog/post"

proxy_country.description: Two-letter ISO country code for the proxy exit location, e.g. "US".

_apiKey.description: Your ScrapingAnt API key. Sign up free at https://app.scrapingant.com/signup

name: scrapingant_extract
description: Extract structured data from a web page using ScrapingAnt AI extraction. Describe the fields you want in `extract_properties` (comma-separated) and get back a JSON object with matching camelCase keys. Example: scrapingant_extract({ url: "https://example.com/product", extract_properties: "product title, price(number), full description", _apiKey: "your-key" })

url.description: The absolute URL of the page to extract data from.

extract_properties.description: Comma-separated free-text description of the fields to extract. Optionally add type/list hints, e.g. "product title, price(number), reviews(list: review title, review content)".

proxy_country.description: Two-letter ISO country code for the proxy exit location, e.g. "US".

_apiKey.description: Your ScrapingAnt API key. Sign up free at https://app.scrapingant.com/signup
